title: Holy priest: no shield on a Balance-talent druid tanking in Dire Bear Form

rules.desc: Holy priest casts no Power Word: Shield on a Balance-talent druid in Dire Bear Form above the critical band in combat
rules.why_expect: FORM_BEAR/FORM_DIREBEAR read as TANK at AiFactory.cpp:495-497 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear :491-515), used by GetPlayerRoles :597-611; with the solo druid as the only tank HasOtherTank (:520-576) finds no other tank, so the form is read and no shield lands above the critical band. #1553 reproduces only with a second tank in the group (see PRI-PWS-BEAR-BAL-2TANK)

rules.desc: Precondition: Dire Bear Form (aura 9634) stays on the player through the fight, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the runner re-casts the stance and excludes time without it
